profile_text.body:
AeroVironment, which refers to itself as AV, describes itself as a leading manufacturer of unmanned aircraft systems, unmanned aerial vehicles, loitering munition systems, and unmanned ground vehicles used for surveillance and reconnaissance by the United States military, U.S. allies, and commercial industries. The company also says it manufactures high-altitude pseudo-satellites.

Its advanced development group is MacCready Works, which the company says turns concepts into mission-ready autonomous systems. Named for Dr. Paul B. MacCready, Jr., the group's engineers, roboticists, and AI researchers design next-generation robotic systems across air, land, and sea. The company describes its approach as the MacCready Method, summarized on its site as build fast, test relentlessly, deploy advantage, with small multidisciplinary teams aiming to move ideas into operational capability in months.

AeroVironment is a public company headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, and trades under the ticker AVAV. Its SEC central index key is 0001368622. Its litigation record shows 152 cases in Virginia.
